entities.name: Elif Şahin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Elif Şahin is a Turkish Volleyball player. She is 1.84 m tall at 68 kg (150 lb) and plays in the Setter position. She plays for Eczacıbaşı Dynavit in Istanbul. She is a member of the Turkey women's national volleyball team.
